name: YesAndSkylight
note: Private family tool. Off the public site and status dashboard by DESIGN D9. This data file exists for the bar-raise / constellation tooling only; it is not linked from any public surface.

barRaise.topFinding: The single most important open item, two full reviews running, is reliability-01: the only off-machine backup was dropped in the 2026-07-30 routine-consolidation fold and, per tonight's canonical audit, is now 16 days stale with no git remote configured, so the entire project exists as exactly one copy on one disk. Nothing since has moved it -- the three commits since the last review are documentation realignment (marking the reverse-API driver dead, correcting stale backup claims) plus a new vitest suite, none of which touch the backup or the milestone tracker's stale scope. A second, closely related finding landed this run: the session cookie is an HMAC of the PIN itself with no separate signing secret, so a leaked cookie is an offline PIN oracle, not just a session hijack. Health moved 66 -> 67, essentially flat, but this run applied the full 19-lens set for the first time (the prior full pass only ran 15), so four new domain lenses surfaced real findings (cloud-edge-worker-cpu-budget, cloud-edge-kv-data-shape both score high and clean at this traffic level; discord-notify and gate-page-publish correctly score not-applicable, this project has neither concern by design).

actions.title: Re-add the nightly off-drive copy step to nightly-sweep (or a standalone task) immediately, and separately run scripts/push-to-github.ps1 to create the private origin.
Wrap the PostalMime.parse call and the pre-try allowlist logEntry calls in their own try/catch that writes a log entry and best-effort replies on failure.
Invert the ALLOWED_SENDERS guard so a missing/empty allowlist rejects every sender by default instead of failing open.
Derive a deterministic id for event creation and treat a 409 (id already exists) as success instead of an error.
Wrap the post-res.ok res.json() call in its own try/catch and treat a parse failure on a 2xx status as a successful-but-unconfirmed write rather than throwing.
Add test/recur.test.ts and test/owners.test.ts covering buildRrule's DST/UNTIL edge cases and resolveOwner/inferOwner's word-boundary matching.
Update the CLAUDE.md debugging bullet to point at DESIGN.md's actual failure mode (permanent 401 version-gate) instead of the stale 400/HAR-diff guidance.
Wrap the fetch call in post() in its own try/catch that shows a failure message on any thrown error, so a network failure stops reading as a permanent green Sending.
Add a cron trigger that performs a real or dry-run write-path check on a schedule and reports failure somewhere Kane already reads.
Add a standalone freshness check reading the last backup snapshot's timestamp and alerting on staleness, decoupled from whether the backup step itself still exists.
Replace scripts/git-guard.ps1 with the current shared portfolio copy (Invoke-Git + LASTEXITCODE-preserving Confirm-GitIntact) and route release.ps1/push-to-github.ps1's git calls through it.
Mint the session cookie from a server-only signing secret over a per-session nonce and issued-at, not an HMAC of the PIN itself, so a leaked cookie stops being an offline PIN oracle.
Bump wrangler to the v4 line, regenerate package-lock.json, and smoke-test wrangler dev + wrangler deploy before shipping.
Re-cut the v0.1 milestone label and completion.remaining around the working Google-event path, drop lists/chores/tasks as dead scope, and fix README's driver description.
Either enable Cloudflare Email Routing on the subdomain now, or drop email quick-add from v0.1 scope and re-label the milestone.
Compute a stable key for each inbound message (Message-ID, or a hash fallback) and check/set it in KV with a short TTL before processing, skipping a repeat.
Skip sky.getCategories/getLists in statePayload when CALENDAR_DRIVER is google, or at minimum run them with Promise.all so their guaranteed failures overlap instead of serializing.
Add one capability gate in router.ts's quickAdd for list/chore/task requests, and hide the corresponding UI tabs / drop the types from the parser's prompt.
Add an AbortController with a short timeout to each outbound fetch (Skylight, Google, Workers AI, email reply).
Add a single bounded retry around the Google Calendar POST for 5xx/network-error responses, matching the 401 retry already in skylight.ts's api().
Extend the KV-log pattern from email.ts to the HTTP quick-add path so failures from any entry point are recorded, not just email.
Apply the existing MAX_TEXT cap to location/description, and validate or encodeURIComponent the listId before it reaches the upstream Skylight API path.
Write a one-time script listing pre-2026-07-24 timed events and correcting or flagging their wrong-timezone offset.
Add a lightweight persistent ledger recording every successful write (source, owner, calendarId, googleEventId, startsAt) independent of the 30-entry display log.
Generate the client-side esc() from the same source as the server-side esc(), or cross-reference both definitions in a comment.
Keep one canonical file table (DESIGN.md) and have CLAUDE.md link to it instead of maintaining a drifting second copy.
Check for a 401 response in post() and redirect to /login instead of displaying the raw server message string.
Persist the last-used owner key to localStorage on selection and pre-select it on load.
Add a single console.error(pathname, message) call in the top-level fetch catch so a 500 is diagnosable from Workers Logs alone.
Surface a rejection/error count from the email log on the authenticated app page.
Add a computed staleness block (days-since-last-audit, days-since-last-backup) to the project's status JSON.
Move ALLOWED_SENDERS/GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID_* to wrangler secret / a non-tracked vars file, or drop wrangler.jsonc from secret_exposure_paths with a documented reason.
Redact family emails/names to placeholders in README.md/DESIGN.md, or remove them from public_artifact_globs and mark them private-only.
Store only the extracted numeric verification code and drop the raw Gmail confirmation link from the logged message, or set an expirationTtl on the email-log KV write.
Add scripts/check-version-pill.ps1 comparing package.json, DESIGN.md, and src/version.ts, called from release.ps1 before commit/deploy.
Add src/version.ts to .project-context.json's version_pill_locations since it's the only pill that reaches users.
Point release.ps1's live check at /api/setup or a new dependency probe instead of '/' so it actually covers the Google Calendar and KV dependencies quick-add needs.
Reject or normalize requests where startsAt and endsAt are supplied in different naive/absolute forms instead of comparing their epochs as-is.
Add narrow response interfaces for the Google Calendar and Skylight response shapes and replace the `any` annotations in google.ts/skylight.ts/parse.ts.
Wrap the env.AI.run call in a try/catch with at least one fallback model id for the Workers AI parser.
Add a one-line private-only banner to the top of FAMILY_CALENDAR_MIGRATION.md matching DESIGN.md's header convention.
Wrap the tsc and wrangler deploy calls (cmd /c ... 2>&1, checking $LASTEXITCODE) so stderr chatter can't abort a successful release.
Check the inbound message's SPF/DKIM/DMARC verdict before trusting the From address as identity, in addition to the allowlist check.
Add a lightweight per-sender or global rate limit around the rejected-sender email branch, mirroring the existing rl:<ip> pattern.
Add an npx vitest run step to release.ps1 alongside the existing typecheck guard so a failing test blocks the release.
Move the ALLOWED_SENDERS check ahead of the Gmail-verification branch and add a lightweight per-sender/IP throttle to the email handler.
